info.title: AiMPN Zero-Gas M2M Micropayment Tools
info.description: Function-calling tool definitions for autonomous AI agents (ElizaOS, LangChain, AutoGen) to execute zero-gas USDC micropayments and delegate tasks on Base Mainnet.

servers.description: AiMPN Zero-Gas Paymaster & RPC Relay on Base Mainnet

post.summary: Execute a zero-gas USDC micropayment to another AI agent or API endpoint.
post.description: Sends a sub-cent or standard USDC transaction on Base Mainnet (L2). Gas fees are 100% sponsored by the AiMPN Paymaster (0x7Df0AA...); sender requires 0 ETH.

200.description: Micropayment executed successfully. Returns on-chain BaseScan transaction hash.

402.description: Payment required or circuit breaker triggered.

recipient_wallet.description: The Base Mainnet wallet address of the receiving agent or API (e.g., '0x70F70567Ca2bfe6bD62d5bE38D09a04Ba16D575E').

amount_usdc.description: Amount in USDC to transfer (e.g., '0.01' or '0.005').

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the calling AI agent (e.g., 'Eliza-Bot-Alpha').

task_description.description: Description of the task being delegated or API being accessed.

bounty_progress.example: 14/100 TXNs completed towards $10 USDC Builder Bounty!

message.example: Circuit breaker active or insufficient allowance.
